correction:
Implement:

CORRECTION
→ LESSON
→ REGRESSION TEST.

Whenever the learning system detects a high-confidence reusable failure, generate a candidate evaluation case.

Example:

User correction:

"You should have compared LMM with repeated-measures ANOVA."

Generate a regression case testing whether the agent now considers:

repeated-measures structure
missingness
imbalance
covariance structure
estimand
candidate model comparison

Do not hard-code one answer unless the evidence genuinely requires one.

The evaluation should test the correct reasoning properties.

Store generated cases under:

learning/evaluations/regression/

Each case must reference:

originating lesson
originating experience
capability
expected behavior
forbidden behavior

Cases become permanent regression assets only after validation.

Do not delete old regression cases merely because the agent now passes them.

They represent institutionalized failures that should not return.

Acceptance criteria:

A meaningful correction can automatically produce a regression candidate.

Repeated mistakes accumulate into a growing regression suite.

Old mistakes remain testable forever unless explicitly retired.
